column1: # A zbus 5.16.0 client session against a scripted bus, recorded 2026-10-16 for
# The oracle: tests/recorder, described in zvariant-5.12.0-values.tsv. The
# runs the SASL handshake and Hello, then calls AddMatch (the rule an AT-SPI
# publisher adds for org.a11y.Status), org.a11y.Bus.GetAddress and a
# Properties.Get the bus refuses, emits an Object:StateChanged event, and
# closes. The scripted bus answers each SASL line as dbus-daemon does (`OK`
# with a fixed GUID, `AGREE_UNIX_FD` when asked) and each call with the
# matching row of zbus-5.16.0-messages.tsv: hello_reply then name_acquired,
# transport: `unix` is a socketpair, where zbus negotiates descriptor passing;
# `nofd` is loopback TCP, where it does not, which is the exchange aterm-dbus
# makes on every socket (it never sends NEGOTIATE_UNIX_FD).
# dir: c2s the client wrote it, s2c the bus did. kind: `line` one SASL line
# with its CRLF (the client's first carries the leading NUL), `msg` one whole
